review_basis.user_finding: A location-only statistic without team analysis is not a meaningful tactical product; player identity may add inspectable team-event context but must not be presented as proof that an allocation is correct.
independent_initial_findings: admit only player_id and a normalized shortName-derived display_name
describe the identity as the actor associated with the first recorded follow-up event rather than a receiver or physical first contact
bind event ID, actor, team role, event and sub-event names, offset, selection rule, and join status
keep attribution, transformation notice, and no-endorsement wording visible
reject fallback player labels and fail closed on every missing actor required by the public fixed example
review_basis.independent_final_finding: PASS after the manifest rights_status enum, fail-closed joins, field minimization, exact event receipts, attribution boundary, and raw-free regression were corrected and hash-bound.

first_recorded_follow_up.selection_rule: earliest event after the corner within the fixed inclusive 10-second window

exact_corroboration.semantic_conclusion: This corroborates the source-linked first recorded follow-up actor only. It does not establish who first touched or received the ball, who won the duel, or whether a tactical decision worked.
